description: This file defines multiple Data Transfer Object (DTO) records used in the LMS backend for various operations such as creating courses, enrolling users, creating assignments, submitting content, grading, and creating discussion threads and posts.

classes.name: CreateCourseRequest
classes.description: DTO for creating a new course, containing code, title, and optional description.

classes.name: EnrollRequest
classes.description: DTO for enrolling a user, identified by userId.

classes.name: CreateAssignmentRequest
classes.description: DTO for creating an assignment with title, description, due date, and maximum points.

classes.name: SubmitRequest
classes.description: DTO for submitting content for an assignment.

classes.name: GradeRequest
classes.description: DTO for grading an assignment, including points awarded and optional feedback.

classes.name: CreateThreadRequest
classes.description: DTO for creating a discussion thread with a title.

classes.name: CreatePostRequest
classes.description: DTO for creating a discussion post with textual content.
